finding.expected: Keep the per-claim invalidation_basis bound at 16, but make the transient current_basis input capable of representing the bounded union of declared basis keys for the exact validated record (without widening discovery or semantic authority), reject duplicates/foreign excess deterministically, and add a focused regression proving a valid record with more than 16 distinct cross-claim basis keys can project VALID when all exact identities are supplied and only affected claims become REFRESH_REQUIRED on a targeted mismatch.
finding.issue: The transient reuse projection reuses _basis(), whose fixed list bound is 16. TASK-224 permits up to 64 claims and up to 16 invalidation-basis entries per claim, with no 16-item record-wide current_basis ceiling. A valid record with more than 16 distinct declared basis keys therefore cannot be projected even when the caller supplies the exact complete current basis, so AC6 is not satisfied for the admitted record space.
